- [ADR-0056 — Dependency update and audit gates](ADR-0056-dependency-update-and-audit-gates.md): Next.js 16.3.8 clears the published `next` advisories (critical `next/og` RCE, high Image Optimization SSRF), with in-range `sharp`, `source-map-js` and `brace-expansion` fixes. Weekly grouped Dependabot updates for npm and Actions. A `Dependency audit` workflow allows no high or critical advisory in the runtime tree and only named exceptions in the full tree; the one exception is `braces`, which has no fixed release and is reached only through lint tooling. Lockfile changes alter DK-06 managed template fingerprints (G5). Owner review pending.

Graph thumbnails were rejected because they follow a file's current version, and the Next.js image optimiser because its cache is not per viewer. Adds no dependency until the build is authorised.

- [Engineering workload register backend](engineering-workload-backend.md): user-authorised BC-01 scoped EN-01 reads; validation and acceptance separate.

- [Projects register from Figma](projects-register-native.md): native desktop/phone register, saved schedule facts and scoped snapshots; Wrike remains reference and hosted release is separate.

- [Excel estimate import design — owner decision](excel-import-figma-design.md): after Claude's audit ranked it the most design-blocked page, Dean asked for the Excel import to be designed and accepted it on 15 October 2026 ("Proceed with your recommendations") as part of the named version "Excel import, Products and Inventory — accepted". It reuses the Estimation Wizard pattern for upload and review, first save, revised-workbook comparison, reviewed source pricing with FX and landed charges, and the Draft quotation. Corrections happen in Excel; re-import warns when it replaces reviewed prices. Thirteen icon-free captures are retained. Building the pages is not decided.

- [Products design — owner decision](products-figma-design.md): Dean asked for the Products (PD-01) page to be redesigned, then left the products/inventory split to Claude. Products keeps what an item is, with one read-only Availability line; stock moves to Inventory. Accepted on 15 October 2026 in the same named version. It supersedes the layout of the [discovery proposal](products-discovery-proposal.md) and keeps its rules. Nine icon-free captures are retained. Amendment A1 (section 8), directed by Dean the same day, adds a product image to the record, thumbnails to the grid, phone list and snapshot, and a No image placeholder; Dean accepted it the same day (named version "Products — product image amendment A1"); nine r02 captures are retained.

- [Inventory design — owner decision](inventory-figma-design.md): the Supply chain page for how many, where and how sure PPO is, extending Stock & reservations (SC-05) and proposing the rail label Inventory. Every quantity meaning is its own row and Unknown is never 0. Accepted on 15 October 2026 in the same named version. Nine icon-free captures are retained; mapping persistence and the build are not decided.

- [Document library design — owner decision](document-library-figma-design.md): the DK-01 register and DK-02 record for the merged document-library backend, drawn in Figma on the accepted register and record patterns and accepted on 15 October 2026 ("Proceed with your recommendations") as the named version "Document library — accepted". Availability, source currentness and review stay separate; registering and revising use a right-side panel and reviewing a centred dialog; links are never retargeted. Routes `/documents` and `/documents/library/{id}`. Eighteen icon-free captures are retained. It supersedes the [PPO-DOCLIB-DES](document-register-linked-library-design.md) layout and keeps its rules. Building the page is not decided.

- [Output, issue and distribution design — owner decision](output-issue-figma-design.md): the DK-03 register and exact-issue record for the merged output register and controlled actions, drawn in Figma on the accepted Document library and Job pack patterns and accepted on 15 October 2026 ("Proceed with your recommendations") as the named version "Output, issue and distribution — accepted". App label "Outputs"; routes `/documents/issues` and `/documents/issues/{family}/{id}`. Preparation, issue, exact bytes, synthetic distribution and responses stay separate; distribution is Synthetic and never Sent or Delivered; each command is one centred dialog. Twenty icon-free captures are retained. It supersedes the [PPO-DK03-DES](output-issue-distribution-design.md) layout and keeps its rules. Building the page is not decided.

- [Template management design — owner decision](template-management-figma-design.md): the DK-06 definitions and proposals registers, definition and proposal records and Job pack Site use for the merged R1–R4 template backend, drawn in Figma on the accepted Outputs and Document library patterns and accepted on 15 October 2026 ("Proceed with your recommendations") as the named version "Template management — accepted". App label "Templates"; register `/documents/templates`. Definition, proposal, review, publication and use assignment stay separate; "Eligible as default" and a site's "Selected now" are labelled apart; Review, Publish and Assign use are centred dialogs. Twenty icon-free captures are retained. It supersedes the [PPO-DK06-DEC](document-form-template-management-design.md) layout and keeps its rules. It records a likely backend defect (G5, managed-definition fingerprint drift). Building the page is not decided.
- [Product image references — proposed decision](product-image-references.md): drafted for Dean's review after Products Amendment A1 left real images undecided. The reference sits on the immutable product revision and names an immutable image source with the exact file version and SHA-256; renditions are a disposable cache; access follows the product revision's read rule inside the product's company; a missing file shows "Image unavailable", never another image. Ten open questions; nothing adopted.

- [My jobs design — owner decision](my-jobs-figma-design.md): the FI-01 technician list (`/my-jobs`) and visit page (`/my-jobs/[id]`), drawn in Figma phone first and on the accepted register and shared record layouts for desktop and tablet. It was accepted on 15 October 2026 ("I accept the My jobs · FI-01 design with your recommendations, including Q9 and Q10") as the named version "My jobs — accepted".
  - The visit has Work, Capture, Pack and Finish tabs.
  - The accepted r05 timer rules are kept, and its remaining states are drawn on phone, desktop and tablet.
  - Offline is a state of the same pages.
  - Crew-aware finish, PNG photos on the phone and a signature pad are adopted.
  - Thirty-nine icon-free captures are retained.
  - r05 stays the built timer baseline. Building the page and the backend changes it implies are not decided.

- [Contract obligations, notices and variations design — owner decision](project-commercial-figma-design.md): the PJ-05 page for the merged commercial-controls backend (#493), drawn in Figma on the accepted register and shared record layouts, polished against the other accepted pages, and accepted on 16 October 2026 ("I accept the PJ-05 Contract obligations, notices and variations design with your recommendations and recommended answers to Q1–Q8") as the named version "Contract obligations, notices and variations — accepted".
  - One project at a time at `/projects/commercial` (menu label "Variations & obligations"), with Variations, Obligations, Notices, Commercial basis and Value breakdown, and a Commercial view on the project record.
  - Requested, priced and approved amounts stay apart; requested and priced are never added; unknown is never $0.00.
  - Decisions are independent and bound to the exact version; notices are evidence only and never sent.
  - Twenty-one icon-free captures are retained. Building the page and the backend reads it implies (G1–G8) are not decided.

- [Appointment detail design — owner decision](appointment-detail-figma-design.md): the SV-04 appointment page (`/service/appointments/[id]`), where the field readiness gate is decided before a crew leaves, drawn in Figma on the shared record layout, polished twice and accepted on 17 October 2026 ("Yes, lock in the polished SV-04 design") as the named version "Appointment detail — shared record layout, accepted".
  - One scrolling page with a readiness Tag in the header; Dispatch held or Ready to dispatch with its reasons; Parts and customer site readiness derived, never ticked by hand.
  - Job pack acknowledgements and Returns, customer contact records (never sent), follow-ups and change requests on the same page.
  - Seven icon-free captures are retained. Building the page is not decided; the gate criteria depend on PR #541.

- [Service planner design — owner decision](service-planner-figma-design.md): the PL-01 planner (`/schedule`) drawn in Figma from the 10 October planner decisions, the field readiness gate and the E9 exemplar. It was refined with Dean and accepted on 17 October 2026 ("I accept the PL-01 Service planner design with your recommendations, including D1–D6 and the two open items as recommended") as the named version "Service planner — accepted".
  - UXB-12 adopted: one tray for To plan and On hold work, and a Needs attention band with one suggested action per row, including the gate's dispatch holds.
  - E9-style cards: 12 px type, one border, initials in the time line, travel as a tinted extension with a car on long segments, and no reasons. Pastel purple circle avatars; away people in full-height dimmed rows.
  - Twelve icon-free captures are retained. Building the page is not decided; hold reasons and a suggestions read come first.

- [Service requests design — owner decision](service-requests-figma-design.md): the SV-01 register (`/service/tickets`, `/service/tickets/new`) and SV-02 request record (`/service/tickets/[id]`), drawn in Figma on the accepted Work orders layouts. Accepted on 17 October 2026 ("I accept the Service requests SV-01 and SV-02 design with your recommendations, including D1–D6 and Q1–Q2") as the named version "Service requests — accepted".
  - Grid register with triage queues in the side menu, a Board view and the large snapshot. Row checkboxes reverse the 23 September D7.
  - The request record has a Before triage bar and view tabs. Complete triage is edited in the tab. Log a request offers to add the call to a matching open request.
  - Thirteen icon-free captures are retained. Building the page is not decided; later stages wait for ADR-0043.

- [Service review and reports design — owner decision](service-review-figma-design.md): the SV-06 register (`/service/reports`) and report record (`/service/reports/[id]`), with SV-07 remaining work and the FI-07 customer response on the report, drawn in Figma on the accepted Work orders layouts. Audited, polished and accepted on 18 October 2026 ("I accept the Service review and reports SV-06 design with your recommendations, including D1–D6 and Q1–Q2") as the named version "Service review and reports — accepted".
  - Grid register with review queues in the side menu and the large snapshot.
  - The report record has a Before issue bar and five view tabs. Review submission is edited in the Evidence tab. The customer report is issued as exact HTML and nothing is sent; responses are bound to that exact report.
  - Twelve icon-free captures are retained. Building the page is not decided.

- [Field team design — owner decision](field-team-figma-design.md): the PL-02 register (`/service/technicians`) and read-only person page (`/service/technicians/[id]`), drawn in Figma on the accepted Service review register, the Work order record layout and the Service planner people rows. Audited, polished and accepted on 18 October 2026 ("I accept the Field team PL-02 design with your recommendations, including D1–D8 and Q1–Q5") as the named version "Field team — accepted".
  - Grid register with Technicians, Visits and Needs preparation in the side menu, the planner's people visuals and the large snapshot.
  - The person page is one scrolling page with seven-day availability, competence evidence in a read-only panel and upcoming visits. Nothing is edited there.
  - Ten icon-free captures are retained. Building the page is not decided.
